originalTitle: GE Vernova, Atlanta Electricals among top beneficiaries of India's transmission expansion
simplifiedContent: India is planning to expand its power transmission system, which is expected to grow due to new policies that support local manufacturing. This means that companies that make equipment for the power grid, like transformers, will likely see an increase in demand. Some foreign companies, like those from China, can participate, but they will have to follow strict rules to ensure they use local content. Companies like GE Vernova and Atlanta Electricals are well-positioned to benefit from this expansion, which could be good news for investors in these companies. This is because they supply equipment needed for the power grid, and with strong demand for high-voltage equipment, they may see increased sales and growth.

originalTitle: Avantel shares jump 10% after Q1 profit surges 67% YoY, revenue climbs 36%
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with Avantel's stock: the company just reported its earnings for the first quarter of the year, and they're really good. The company made 36% more money than it did during the same time last year, and its profit increased by 67%. Because of this, the price of Avantel's stock went up by 10% on Monday. This matters because it shows that the company is doing well and making more money, which can be a good sign for investors. Foreign investors also seem to think the company is doing well, as they increased their investment in Avantel during the quarter.

originalTitle: US Stock Market: Inflation gathers pace as tariffs, energy costs and AI investment lift price pressures, says Fed
simplifiedContent: The US stock market is feeling the effects of rising inflation, which means prices for goods and services are going up. This increase in inflation is partly due to tariffs (taxes on imported goods) and higher energy costs. The Federal Reserve, which helps control the economy, says that inflation is currently higher than they want it to be. However, the job market is doing okay, and investments in artificial intelligence are helping the economy grow at a moderate pace. The people in charge of making decisions about interest rates (which affect borrowing and spending) can't agree on what to do next, which could impact the economy and the stock market.

originalTitle: LTM needs faster revenue growth to meet FY27 goal
simplifiedContent: A company called LTM has a goal to grow its revenue (the amount of money it makes) in the current financial year (FY27). However, its first quarter results were not very strong, which makes it harder for the company to meet its goal. Analysts (people who study and predict how companies will do) are warning that LTM needs to grow its revenue faster if it wants to reach its target. This means that LTM will have to do better in the coming quarters to meet its goal. The company's slow start to the year has raised concerns about whether it can actually achieve its planned growth.

originalTitle: CarTrade Tech share price gains after UBS assigns ‘Buy’ call, sees over 42% upside potential
simplifiedContent: A big investment company called UBS thinks CarTrade Tech is a good stock to buy, which has made the stock's price go up. The price of CarTrade Tech has already been going up - it's increased by 19% in the last month and 56% in the last three months. In the last year, the stock's price has risen by 48%, and it's done even better over two and three years, with big increases of 237% and 443%. This means people who bought the stock a while ago have made a lot of money, and UBS thinks it will keep going up. The company's "Buy" call suggests that they think the stock will continue to be a good investment.

originalTitle: Stocks to buy or sell: Dharmesh Shah of ICICI Sec suggests buying Shriram Finance, Brigade Enterprise on 13 July
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: The main stock market indicators in India, called Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex, went down on Monday. This means that the overall value of the stocks in the market decreased. The reason for this decrease is related to tensions in the Middle East and higher crude oil prices. This change in the market matters because it can affect the value of the stocks you own or are thinking of buying. Overall, the market was down, with all sectors being affected.
